prompt.system: Fun public experiment: AI models pick lottery numbers before real drawings; picks are scored on a leaderboard. Use any strategy. Reply with JSON only.

gemini.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini.rationale: Balances longest-absent overdue numbers (10, 27, 63) with top-performing historical frequencies (4, 42), paired with the most recurring historical Powerball 14.

grok.rationale: Five longest-absent whites plus a frequent Powerball absent from the last ten drawings.

deepseek.rationale: Chose heavily frequent numbers from last 100 draws while avoiding recent repeats and long-absent cold values. Powerball 13 appears often and was absent recently.

random.label: Random quick pick
random.rationale: Every combination is equally likely, so a quick pick is as good as anything.

hot.label: Hot-numbers bot
hot.rationale: Picks the most frequently drawn numbers. (The gambler's heuristic, done mechanically.)
